title: Giant Sapling (Crushing Cavern) - Timed Fight Guide
description: The Giant Sapling in Expedition 33's Crushing Cavern is a timed DPS check - the walls crush you on its 7th turn. Location, attack pattern and how to win.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content:
The Giant Sapling is an optional boss inside the Crushing Cavern, and it is not a normal fight - it is a timed DPS check with a hard fail state.

The cavern walls close in at the start of every one of the Sapling's turns. On its 7th turn, they crush your party and the fight ends immediately in failure.

sections.title: Where to Find the Giant Sapling
sections.content:
Location: Crushing Cavern.

The cavern entrance is northwest of Gestral Village, on the northern part of the Act 1 island - approached from the water. It also sits north of the Lost Woods and Yellow Harvest on the overworld map.

The cavern becomes accessible after completing Act 1, once Esquie can swim.

Inside: follow the dark cave until you fall through the floor. At the bottom you will see two large glowing eyes - strike them to begin the fight. If you want to leave instead, there is a rope back up behind and to the right of the drop point.

The fight is a quantity-of-damage problem rather than an elemental one - the constraint is the turn limit, not a resistance table.

sections.title: How to Beat the Giant Sapling
sections.content:
It only has two moves

On each of its turns it does exactly one of these:

  • Applies 6 Shields to itself
  • Fires 3 purple orbs that inflict Exhausted on anyone hit

Winning means repeatedly stripping the shields and never losing turns to Exhausted.

The shield answer

Maelle's Breaking Rules is exceptional here - it removes all shields, deals damage, and restores AP per shield removed. Lune's Tremor also removes all shields if you are running Lune.

Orb timing

The orbs arc upward and then curve sharply down. The correct dodge/parry window is just as the orb starts curving downward. They travel quickly, so this is the main execution hurdle.

Your Speed stat is a damage stat here

The limit is counted in the Sapling's turns, not yours. Higher party Speed means you take more turns before its 7th - so Speed effectively buys you damage. This is one of the few fights where Speed is directly a DPS stat.

Build advice

Prioritise attack power over defence. You are not trying to survive a long fight - you are trying to finish inside a short one.
